title: Late-Mailed Notices of Intent to Sell under Repossession and Collateral Recovery
content:
Compliance term for a notice of intent to sell mailed some time after the vehicle came into the company's possession under Repossession and Collateral Recovery.

**Rule.** Where the notice is mailed more than 14 calendar days after the recovery date, 7 days are added; where it is mailed more than 7 but no more than 14 calendar days after the recovery date, 4 days are added; where it is mailed no more than 7 calendar days after the recovery date, no late-mailing days are added.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical recovery date of 1 April)

| Mailing date | Calendar days after the recovery date | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| 8 April | 7 | none |
| 9 April | 8 | 4 |
| 15 April | 14 | 4 |
| 16 April | 15 | 7 |

The count is the calendar days from the recovery date on the case to the mailing date of the notice.
